title: Newmark Appointed Exclusive Office Leasing Agent for 2727 Paces Ferry in Atlanta, Georgia
summary: Newmark announces the Company has been appointed the exclusive leasing agent for 2727 Paces Ferry, an approximately 640,000-square-foot, Class A office…
body_markdown:
**September 16, 2026 9:00 AM**
Newmark announces the Company has been appointed the exclusive leasing agent for 2727 Paces Ferry, an approximately 640,000-square-foot, Class A office property comprising two 18-story towers in Atlanta’s Vinings district. Executive Managing Director[Craig Kalinowski](https://www.nmrk.com/people/craig-kalinowski) and Senior Managing Director[Brad Kirschner](https://www.nmrk.com/people/brad-kirschner) are leading the leasing assignment on behalf of ownership, Insignia, LLC.


Ownership is repositioning 2727 Paces Ferry as a premier work-live-play destination, introducing an expansive new amenity environment with a coffee bar and café, tenant lounge and library, conference facilities, coworking areas, restaurant space and indoor-outdoor gathering areas.


“2727 Paces Ferry presents a compelling opportunity to deliver a truly differentiated office experience in one of Metro Atlanta’s most desirable locations,” said Kirschner. “We are proud to support ownership on a vision that pairs the caliber of a premier Class A office offering with the design, service and amenities of a hospitality environment. This transformation will further distinguish the property and create a destination that meets the evolving expectations of forward-thinking companies and their employees.”


The repositioning builds on 2727 Paces Ferry’s existing offering, which includes a fitness center, café, conference and training facilities, outdoor green space and patios and covered parking. The property accommodates a range of office requirements, from regional operations to corporate headquarters, and features flexible floorplates and expansive views across Metro Atlanta.


“Appointing Newmark is an important step as we begin executing our vision for 2727 Paces Ferry,” said Eti S. Lazarian, Chief Executive Officer of Insignia, LLC. “We’re repositioning both towers around a hospitality-inspired workplace experience focused on thoughtful design, service, wellbeing and connection.”


Chaz. Lazarian, Chairman of Insignia, LLC added, “2727 Paces Ferry’s scale, Atlanta location and large-block availability create a rare opportunity in today’s market. We are making a significant investment in both towers to realize the property’s full potential.”


The property offers immediate access to I-285 and proximity to I-75, providing connectivity throughout Metro Atlanta. Its Vinings location places tenants within an established mix of residential, dining, retail and entertainment offerings, including Truist Park and the Cobb Energy Performing Arts Centre, further supporting the property’s work-live-play positioning.


**About Newmark** Newmark Group, Inc.
